To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
outsourcing has been a robust practice for over two decades, but the practice is now evolving to a more complex set of practices.

1) the outsourcing of business processes and information technology (IT) services is a robust business practice, 2) the outsourcing of IT services is a robust practice that is more robust in certain contexts and for specific types of services, 3) the outsourcing of BPO is more robust in some contexts and for some types of services, and 4) cloud services are robust for certain services, but the outsourcing of cloud services is not yet a robust practice.
